description: Scrape products from B&H Photo Video (bhphotovideo.com). Search by keyword, browse categories, fetch product details, or scrape from URLs.

fetchDetails.description: When enabled in search/category modes, visits each product page to fetch full specs and description. Slower but more complete.
fetchDetails.title: Fetch full product details

inStockOnly.description: When enabled, only emit products that are currently in stock.
inStockOnly.title: In-stock items only

maxItems.description: Maximum number of products to emit.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Skip products priced above this value.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (USD)

minPrice.description: Skip products priced below this value.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (USD)

minRating.description: Only emit products with rating >= this value (1.0–5.0).
minRating.title: Minimum star rating

enumTitles: Fetch product details by product ID or SKU
Scrape one or more product URLs
mode.title: Mode

productIds.description: List of B&H product IDs (numeric, e.g. '1769090') or B&H SKUs (e.g. 'CAER1001845'). Used with mode=productDetails.
productIds.title: Product IDs (mode=productDetails)

searchQuery.description: Keyword or phrase to search for (mode=search).
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: How to sort search or category results.
sortBy.title: Sort results by

startUrls.description: List of B&H Photo product or search page URLs to scrape.
startUrls.title: Start URLs (mode=byUrl)

title: B&H Photo Scraper Input
